title: WebJEA Configuration
description: Configuration schema for WebJEA - a web-based JEA execution framework.

$schema.description: Link to this schema. WebJEA accepts and ignores it.

Title.description: The page title displayed in WebJEA.

BasePath.description: Default folder path for scripts with relative paths.

LogParameters.description: Log form inputs to the audit log. Can be overridden per command.

PermittedGroups.description: Global access groups or users. Members have access to all commands. With Windows authentication, use domain\group. With Entra ID, use a group or user object ID (GUID), a UPN, an app role value, or a group display name when ResolveGroupNamesViaGraph is enabled. '*' is not honored here in production.

DashboardHtml.description: An HTML string displayed on the landing page. Can be used for instructions, help text, or branding.

HtmlLanguage.description: Default language for HTML output, used by screen readers and assistive technologies.

ShowVerbose.description: Whether members of the global PermittedGroups can see verbose output. Applies to global users only; other users never see verbose output. There is no per-command override.

DefaultCommandId.description: DEPRECATED as of v2026.5.2.1922. The ID of the command to display by default.

RenderMode.description: Default rendering mode for command output. Can be overridden per command. 'Markdown' and 'Link' require WebJEA v2100 or later.

Commands.description: Array of command definitions available in WebJEA.

Command.title: command
Command.description: A command shown in the WebJEA menu, backed by a PowerShell script.

Id.description: Unique, case-insensitive identifier (stored lowercased). Used in URL parameters (?id=<value>). Duplicate Ids are rejected when the config loads.

Description.description: DEPRECATED. Valid only up to WebJEA v2026.4.x. Description text for the command.

Synopsis.description: Description text for the landing page. Can contain HTML. Will be displayed on the dashboard below the command title.

OnloadScript.description: Script to execute on page load. Should not require parameters and should run quickly.

Script.description: Script to parse for form generation and execution.

LogParameters.description: Override config-level LogParameters for this command. When null or omitted, the config-level value applies.

PermittedGroups.description: Groups or users with access to this command. Use '*' for all authenticated users. With Windows authentication, use domain\group. With Entra ID, use a group or user object ID (GUID), a UPN, an app role value, or a group display name when ResolveGroupNamesViaGraph is enabled. When omitted, only members of the global PermittedGroups can see the command.

RenderMode.description: Rendering mode for output of this command. When null or omitted, the config-level RenderMode applies, which defaults to 'Legacy'. 'Markdown' and 'Link' require WebJEA v2100 or later.
